population: B2B clean-train folds0-3 only (1421 fixed V8 trajectories); fold4=611 and B2B 581 sealed
signal: frozen clean-lineage V13 ordinal mask-value logits at each V8 prefix; no Target calls, gold answer, exact fidelity, or attainable mask in the signal
probe: four query-grouped out-of-fold linear logistic fits of depth fraction, token fraction, five V13 logits and 0.90 logit change from prior prefix; fixed 100 epochs and training-fold standardization as DEP-A0
online_decoding: first prefix whose direct or fitted 0.90 logit is nonnegative, else depth12; stop only on current or past prefixes
offline_diagnostic: argmax safe-window score across all 13 prefix states as an optimistic upper bound, never called an online cutoff
train_only_go_gate: fitted online first-crossing must improve fixed-depth10 0.90 success and reduce mean context fraction on the 1421, while query-grouped optimistic hit must exceed DEP-A0 depth-only prior; otherwise do not access fold4=611
interpretation: V13 has ancestry exposure to these train queries, so any positive result requires a lineage-clean test before a deployment claim; negative result is limited to this frozen head and linear calibration
